instructions.1: Mix the flour with the sugar, yeast, salt and baking powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the ashta, laban, butter and oil and knead until smooth and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Cover with plastic and a clean towel and prove until doubled.
instructions.4: Cut into lemon-sized balls.
instructions.5: Fill each with the sugar-cinnamon mix and seal well.
instructions.6: Set the balls in a dish of sugar and toasted sesame.
instructions.7: Arrange on an oiled tray and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Bake at 200°C until golden.
instructions.9: Serve hot with tea for breakfast or dinner.

fah-758.title: No-Knead Croissants
fah-758.culturalNotes: Freeze for a long time and use as needed.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in the microwave.
instructions.2: Add the laban or yogurt and the milk to the melted butter.
instructions.3: Add the baking powder, sugar and salt and mix well.
instructions.4: Dip two filo sheets in the mix and coat well.
instructions.5: Lay a third sheet over them.
instructions.6: Put the cream or feta cheese filling in the centre.
instructions.7: Halve the filo and roll each half into a croissant.
instructions.8: Repeat for the rest.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray.
instructions.10: Brush the tops with a little butter.
instructions.11: Add sesame or nigella to taste.
instructions.12: Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.13: Serve hot with your favourite drink.

fah-759.title: Quick No-Knead Croissants
fah-759.culturalNotes: Brush every sheet well for a flaky croissant. Sweet or savory fillings work.

instructions.1: Mix the oil, cream or ashta and sparkling water in a bowl.
instructions.2: Brush every filo sheet well with the mix.
instructions.3: Stack the brushed sheets.
instructions.4: Cut the roll into small or large triangles.
instructions.5: Fill each with your favourite filling.
instructions.6: Arrange on an oiled or silicone-lined tray.
instructions.7: Brush with a mix of half a cup of oil and a quarter cup of water.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C.
instructions.9: Bake for 30–40 minutes until flaky and golden.

fah-760.title: Crepe (No Eggs or Milk)
fah-760.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge up to 3 days, the freezer up to a month. Add different fillings when serving.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornflour, salt, sugar and milk powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and water and blend until smooth.
instructions.3: Strain out the lumps through a sieve.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over medium, wipe a drop of oil with a tissue.
instructions.5: Ladle the batter in and swirl to coat.
instructions.6: Flip when the edges lift off.
instructions.7: Cook until lightly coloured.
instructions.8: Take out and cool slightly.
instructions.9: Prepare your favourite filling (ketchup, mayonnaise, cheese, green pepper, olives).
instructions.10: Spread on half the crepe and close it.
instructions.11: Toast again in the pan until crisp.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-761.title: Fettuccine Crepe
fah-761.culturalNotes: Add a little melted chocolate or fresh fruit when serving.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add water gradually while stirring.
instructions.3: Add the egg and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the milk and mix until smooth.
instructions.5: Add the oil or butter and mix again.
instructions.6: Heat a pan over medium and oil lightly.
instructions.7: Pour in some batter and spread evenly.
instructions.8: Flip when the edges go golden.
instructions.9: Take out and repeat until the batter's done.
instructions.10: Cut the crepes into thin strips.
instructions.11: Serve with a little ice cream.

fah-762.title: Crispy Sugar Balls
fah-762.culturalNotes: Water works instead of milk. Smaller balls are crispier.

fah-762-i9.name: Syrup, honey, icing sugar or cinnamon

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornflour, sugar, salt, baking powder and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add warm milk gradually and knead until cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover and prove for 30 minutes in a warm place.
instructions.4: Cut small and shape into little balls.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan over medium and add the balls.
instructions.6: Turn constantly until golden.
instructions.7: Cook until crisp outside and soft inside.
instructions.8: Drain and toss in syrup, honey, icing sugar or cinnamon.

fah-763.title: Savory Olive & Cheese Cake
fah-763.culturalNotes: Top with an egg or labneh if you like. Keeps in the fridge up to 3 days. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with the vinegar and salt in a deep bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt or laban and the oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the flour and baking powder and mix until smooth.
instructions.4: Fold in the grated cheese.
instructions.5: Pour into a 25×30 baking-paper-lined tray.
instructions.6: Scatter the olives, tomato and thyme on top.
instructions.7: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes or until golden.
instructions.8: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-764.title: Savory Egg Cake
fah-764.culturalNotes: Serve with toast and pickled peppers or anything you like. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs, milk and ghee with the salt, pepper and paprika.
instructions.2: Add the flour gradually, mixing until smooth.
instructions.3: Add the sausages, mixed cheese, bell pepper, olives, parsley, paprika and hot pepper.
instructions.4: Stir until combined.
instructions.5: Heat the oven to 180°C.
instructions.6: Grease the tin with ghee and dust with flour or line with baking paper.
instructions.7: Pour the batter into the tin.
instructions.8: Bake on the middle shelf.
instructions.9: Bake for 20 minutes or until browned on top and the cheese melts.
instructions.10: Cut and serve hot.

fah-765.title: Damietta Meshabak
fah-765.culturalNotes: The oil should be hot over medium heat so the meshabak fries without going dark. Shape bigger or smaller as you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornflour, salt, sugar and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add a tablespoon of blossom or rose water.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually and knead to a pancake-batter consistency.
instructions.4: Cover with plastic and a clean towel and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Separately, boil the sugar, water and lemon juice for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Add the white honey or glucose and mix, then cool the syrup.
instructions.7: Put the batter in a plastic bag and snip a small hole.
instructions.8: Heat oil over medium and pipe the meshabak shapes, frying until golden.
instructions.9: Dip the fried meshabak in the cold syrup.
instructions.10: Repeat for all the batter.

fah-766.title: Maamoul (Bag & Press Method)
fah-766.culturalNotes: Store in a sealed tin away from moisture to keep them crisp. The dough keeps in the fridge if you're making a big batch.

instructions.1: Beat the ghee in the mixer until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the sifted icing sugar and beat for 4–5 minutes until creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, beating after each.
instructions.4: Add the orange vanilla, salt and baking powder and stir.
instructions.5: Add the milk with the baker's ammonia and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the sifted flour and cornflour and knead until combined.
instructions.7: Wet your hands and shape with the piping bag or the press.
instructions.8: Space the pieces on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Cool before serving.

fah-767.title: Quick Pan Manakeesh
fah-767.culturalNotes: Any topping — thyme and oil, any cheese, or spiced meat with cheese. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, sugar and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil, yogurt and warm milk and knead until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover in an oiled dish and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut into small balls and roll each very thin.
instructions.6: Heat a pan over medium with a teaspoon of oil.
instructions.7: Cook the dough until golden underneath, then flip.
instructions.8: Add your topping (thyme, cheese, spiced meat) and cook until golden on the other side.
instructions.9: Serve hot with tea or milk tea.

fah-768.title: Manakeesh with Thyme & Labneh
fah-768.culturalNotes: Serve hot with tea for the best taste.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, baking powder, salt, sugar and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and warm water gradually and mix until a dough forms.
instructions.3: Set in an oiled dish, cover with plastic and prove for an hour.
instructions.4: Roll the proved dough into a rectangle on a floured surface.
instructions.5: Spread the labneh and cut 2 cm strips.
instructions.6: Coil the strips and space them on an oiled tray.
instructions.7: Cover and prove again for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Brush with the egg-milk wash and bake for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Cover for 5 minutes before serving.

fah-769.title: Cinnamon & Sugar Softies
fah-769.culturalNotes: Freeze in bags or sealed boxes for later.

instructions.1: Mix the oil, ghee, ashta, water and yogurt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, yeast, vanilla, vinegar, salt and baking powder and mix well.
instructions.3: Add 5 cups of sifted flour and knead until soft and tender.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for half an hour.
instructions.5: Make the filling: a cup of sugar, a tablespoon of cinnamon, a teaspoon of cocoa, a tablespoon of butter and nuts to taste.
instructions.6: Make the coating: a cup of toasted sesame, 2 tablespoons of sugar and a tablespoon of ghee.
instructions.7: Shape equal balls and stuff with the filling.
instructions.8: Roll the balls in the coating and arrange on a tray.
instructions.9: Prove for half an hour.
instructions.10: Bake at the highest heat for 15 minutes until browned.
instructions.11: Serve hot with tea.

fah-770.title: Waffles & Pancakes
fah-770.culturalNotes: Homemade or store-bought caramel sauce both work. Add any fruit.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add a cup and a half of milk gradually, whisking.
instructions.3: Add the egg, vanilla and butter or oil and whisk until smooth.
instructions.4: Rest the batter.
instructions.5: Separately, whisk the icing sugar and yogurt.
instructions.6: Add the half cup of oil gradually and whisk until smooth.
instructions.7: Thin half the chocolate sauce with 4 spoons of milk.
instructions.8: Heat the waffle maker and oil it.
instructions.9: Add batter and cook for 7–10 minutes.
instructions.10: No waffle maker? Use an oiled pan over medium.
instructions.11: Pour the batter for pancakes.
instructions.12: Serve with chocolate spread, strawberries, bananas, caramel sauce and ice cream.

fah-771.title: Super-Flaky Date Roses (Breakfast & Dinner)
fah-771.culturalNotes: The date paste must be cold when filling so it doesn't melt. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the yeast, baking powder, sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil, milk and warm water gradually and knead until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Rest for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut into egg-sized balls.
instructions.5: Roll each and fill with date paste.
instructions.6: Section the rolled dough and snip to form the rose.
instructions.7: Lightly oil the tray and set the roses on it.
instructions.8: Prove again for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush with the milk-powder-coffee-sugar-water glaze.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame to taste.
instructions.11: Bake at 220°C.
instructions.12: Bake for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Serve hot with tea, Nescafé or cappuccino.
